name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Exactly one of these is true: Mara goes with Druid; Sable goes with Greataxe; Druid goes with Quarterstaff.
Either Cleric goes with Longbow or Mara goes with Druid.
Ranger goes with exactly one of Sable, Longbow, or Quarterstaff.
Between Cleric and Druid, one goes with Sable and the other with Thorne.

hints.text: Suppose Mara went with Cleric — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Mara goes with Cleric.
Cleric goes with Mara, so Sable can't go with Cleric.
Cleric goes with Mara, so Thorne can't go with Cleric.
…but now the clue “Between Cleric and Druid, one goes with Sable and the other with Thorne” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Mara does not go with Cleric.

hints.text: Suppose Mara went with Druid — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Mara goes with Druid.
Druid goes with Mara, so Sable can't go with Druid.
Druid goes with Mara, so Thorne can't go with Druid.
…but now the clue “Between Cleric and Druid, one goes with Sable and the other with Thorne” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Mara does not go with Druid.
